knobs.note: Read by bin/reconcile-prs.sh as ${MC_CLOSED_SETTLE:-180}. Registered by BH-1165 so it is visible and settable; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

BH-1583: the ONE box that runs this lane. `hub` = whichever box bin/lib/hub-box.sh calls the hub; any other value is one fleet box name (bin/box-name.sh). Every other box exits before any console or GitHub read and says so once per value in logs/reconcile.log. The value is only compared with this box's own fleet name — it names nothing to run, contact or write — so the worst row is the wrong box (or none) reconciling, which that log line and the console's stale Merge buttons show. Read by bin/lib/reconcile-read.sh with no literal. BH-1609: checked at write time (PUT /api/settings) against box_status; `hub` is always allowed, and an empty fleet list is accepted with a warning.

BH-1583: per_page of the one pulls?state=closed&sort=updated&direction=desc read per repo per tick. 30 keeps the page under gh-rest-etag.sh's 1 MiB body cap (GH_ETAG_MAX_BYTES), so an unchanged page answers 304 and is not counted; a bigger page answers more PRs per read but may lose the ETag. Read by bin/lib/reconcile-read.sh with no literal.

BH-1583: at most this many single GET pulls/<n> reads per tick, for tracked PRs the repo's recent-closed page cannot answer (closed long ago, or open with no proved watermark yet). The rest wait for the next tick, and the tick logs how many. 0 = never read a single PR. Read by bin/lib/reconcile-read.sh with no literal.

BH-1583: a repo whose list read answered 404 (renamed, deleted, or not visible to this identity) is recorded once and not read again — list or single PR — until this many seconds have passed. Read by bin/lib/reconcile-read.sh with no literal.

BH-1583 (review of #1593): a PR whose single GET pulls/<n> read FAILED is not read again for this many seconds, so a PR that keeps failing cannot take one of the RECONCILE_PRS_FALLBACK_CAP slots every tick and starve the PRs behind it. 0 = retry every tick. Read by bin/lib/reconcile-read.sh with no literal.
